description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

Mercor AI Capability Research Grants $5M

One of the biggest challenges facing the industry today is determining whether frontier AI is capable enough to deliver value in real-world settings. A model can perform well on benchmarks and still struggle in production. That’s why investing in capabilities research, realistic evaluations, and robust verification is critical.

Mercor is committing $5 million to fund AI capabilities research. The grant supports:

- The time of experts from Mercor's platform

- Researcher hours

- API credits

- Stipends for event and conference attendance

This is separate from the Mercor Research Fellowship, which funds individual experts (apply HERE https://www.mercor.com/careers/a0a98be0-d856-4129-b500-c0a3e412ef01/) and our $5m of safety funding awards (apply HERE https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mercor/1d59ce50-4207-4d95-b7fd-5a01e90b0897).

What we're looking for

- Real-world evaluations: measuring whether benchmark performance translates into reliable performance on realistic tasks and workflows

- Environments: building high-fidelity, interactive environments that capture the complexity of real-world work

- Long-horizon tasks: evaluating and improving models’ ability to plan, execute, and adapt across extended workflows

- Agentic capabilities: tool use, coordination, memory, and autonomous execution

- Reasoning and problem-solving: improving performance on complex, ambiguous, or underspecified tasks

- Post-training: developing better data, rewards, and training methods to improve model capabilities

- Evaluation methodology: creating more robust measures of capability, reliability, and real-world utility

Why us

- Funding for autonomous frontier-work.

- Access to Mercor's expert network for human grading and annotation: lawyers, accountants, engineers, scientists, clinicians

- Access to Mercor's internal evaluation infrastructure, subject to review

- Introductions to Mercor's network of researchers across frontier labs and academia

WHO SHOULD APPLY

- Academic groups, independent researchers, and non-profit organizations

- People with a specific, well-scoped question: the grant is built around your proposal, not a generic research rotation

- Bonus: researchers with experience with agentic evaluation, RL environments, and post-training.

We expect grantees to publish - such as a paper, an open dataset, a public methodology, or a tool the field can use.

How to apply

Submit an Expression of Interest. We expect to see a one- or two-page document. It should contain at least a section on your team, background, and research accomplishments; a section on your proposed research project; and a section on the outputs and impact of the project, with directionally correct timelines and resource requirements.

Stellenbeschreibung:
Unsere Herausforderung: Über 8.000 Stunden pro Jahr. So lange sitzt der Durchschnittsmensch - mit Folgen wie Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes und nachlassender mentaler Gesundheit. Obwohl das vielen bewusst ist, fällt es den meisten schwer, Bewegung in ihren vollen Alltag zu integrieren.
Bei Moovv , gegründet 2024, ändern wir das. Wir entwickeln innovative Laufbänder, die Bewegung nahtlos in den Alltag integrieren - zu Hause, im Büro oder irgendwo dazwischen.
Unsere Mission ist klar: Gesundheit und Bewegung für alle zugänglich machen - denn selbst die beschäftigsten Menschen verdienen ein gesundes Leben. Der Beweis liegt in den Zahlen: Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bewerten uns auf Trustpilot mit 4,6 ⭐ .
Wer wir sind: Wir sind ein junges, motiviertes Team mit einer gemeinsamen Mission : mehr Gesundheit und Bewegung in das Leben der Menschen zu bringen. Wir arbeiten kollaborativ, handeln pragmatisch und leben, was wir predigen.
Deine Chance: Während wir schnell in den Niederlanden, Belgien und Deutschland skalieren, bauen wir das Kernteam auf, das unseren Erfolg prägen wird. Als unser Community Manager wirst du Moovv zu mehr als nur einer Marke machen - zu einem Ort, an dem Menschen dazugehören möchten. Du verbindest Menschen, inspirierst kreative Initiativen und verwandelst WhatsApp und Instagram in lebendige Zentren voller Energie und Engagement.
Deine Aufgaben:

• Beziehungsaufbau: Du bist die herzliche, vertrauenswürdige Ansprechperson für unsere Ambassadors und Creator. Du baust Vertrauen auf, hörst aufmerksam zu und sorgst dafür, dass sich Menschen wirklich gesehen fühlen.

• Community-Aktivierung: Du bringst unsere WhatsApp-Community täglich zum Leben - mit kreativen Challenges, spannenden Formaten und echten Gesprächen.

• Instagram-Engagement: Du beantwortest DMs, Kommentare und Erwähnungen und gehst proaktiv auf Kund:innen und Ambassadors zu, um bedeutungsvolle Gespräche zu starten.

• Kreative Aktionen: Ob Laufclubs, Creator-Kooperationen oder große Community-Events - du planst und setzt Initiativen um, die Menschen zusammenbringen.

• Wachstum & Bindung: Du überlegst strategisch, wie du neue Creator, Kund:innen und Partner:innen für unsere Community gewinnst, aktivierst und langfristig bindest.

Das bringst du mit:

• Community-First-Mindset: Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung im Aufbau und Management engagierter Communities - idealerweise auf WhatsApp und Instagram.

• Vernetzer/in mit Kreativfunken: Du entwickelst neue Ideen, um Menschen online und offline zusammenzubringen, und schaffst dabei unvergessliche Erlebnisse.

• Menschliche Energie: Du förderst auf natürliche Weise Wertschätzung, Positivität und echte zwischenmenschliche Verbindung.

• Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst an, bewegst Dinge schnell und wartest nicht auf perfekte Bedingungen.

• Bonus: Erfahrung mit Sport-Communities, Creator-Management oder Eventplanung.

• Sprachen: Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch.

Bereit, mit uns die Welt in Bewegung zu bringen?
Bewirb dich jetzt auf Indeed oder per Mail an:
Ich freue mich auf dich!

title: Medical Administrative Assistant and Insurance Verification Specialist
description:
About the Role
We're seeking a detail-oriented Intake Specialist / Insurance Authorizations professional to join a compassionate, fast-paced psychiatric practice serving children, adolescents, and adults. This practice offers a full range of psychiatric care under one roof - including NeuroStar TMS therapy for treatment-resistant depression - and this role plays a key part in making sure patients get to treatment without unnecessary delays.
You'll be the first voice many patients hear, gathering the information needed to get them scheduled and authorized for care - with a strong focus on NeuroStar TMS insurance authorizations , one of the most detail-intensive parts of this practice's workflow. NeuroStar authorizations typically require documenting prior antidepressant trials and medical necessity criteria before a payer will approve treatment, and much of that documentation and tracking runs through TrakStar , NeuroStar's dedicated patient data management portal.
What You'll Do
Patient Intake

• Speak directly with new and existing patients by phone to gather and accurately document demographic information, medical history, insurance details, reason for visit, and other required intake information prior to evaluation

• Prepare and set up patient charts prior to evaluations, ensuring all necessary information and documentation is complete and accurate

Insurance Authorizations & Verification

• Manage insurance authorizations and verification, including working within insurance portals and payer platforms

• Handle NeuroStar TMS-specific authorizations , including documenting medical necessity criteria (e.g., prior antidepressant trials) required by most payers

• Track and manage TMS-related patient data and authorization documentation within TrakStar

Scheduling & Patient Communication

• Schedule new patient evaluations, follow-up appointments, and patient recall

• Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls (150-250 calls per day) with a professional, patient-focused approach

Administrative Support

• Collect copays and process patient payments

• Process prescription refill requests

Requirements
Required Qualifications

•
Minimum of 2 years of medical experience , preferably in psychiatry, behavioral health, or mental health

•
Experience with TMS therapy is highly preferred , given this role's strong focus on TMS insurance authorizations

• Strong experience with insurance authorizations and verification , including working with insurance portals and payer platforms

•
Experience with NeuroStar and/or TrakStar is strongly preferred - direct familiarity with NeuroStar's authorization requirements and the TrakStar portal is a significant advantage for this role

• Comfortable managing a high volume of calls while staying professional and patient-focused

• Experience scheduling new patient evaluations, follow-up appointments, and patient recall

• Experience collecting copays and processing patient payments

• Experience processing prescription refill requests

•
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills - clear, fluent English is a non-negotiable requirement for this role

Benefits
Why This Role
You'll be a critical link between patients and the psychiatric care they need - especially for those pursuing NeuroStar TMS therapy, where getting authorization right the first time can mean the difference between timely treatment and frustrating delays. It's meaningful, fast-paced work with real impact on patients' mental health journeys.
